instruction: Design a Knowledge Graph architecture. using a Microservices style. deployed on Azure. satisfying: Data Lakehouse Pattern, Compliance/Audit Logging.

threats.name: Data Leakage
threats.description: Sensitive data is exposed in transit or at rest.

threats.name: Data Tampering
threats.description: Data is maliciously modified.

threats.name: Lateral Movement
threats.description: Attackers move through the network searching for key assets.

threats.name: DDoS
threats.description: Distributed Denial of Service attacking service availability.

threats.name: Session Hijacking
threats.description: Attackers take over an active user session.

threats.name: Log Evasion
threats.description: Attackers can perform actions without generating audit trails.

threats.name: Unauthorized Access
threats.description: Attackers can access systems or data without proper identity verification.

threats.name: Credential Stuffing
threats.description: Automated injection of breached username/password pairs.

recommendations: Encrypt sensitive data at rest and in transit.
Add API Gateway to secure and manage external traffic.
Add Authentication service to protect user access.
Deploy a SIEM for security event aggregation and threat detection.
security.security_summary: Architecture contains a frontend, an API service and a database but lacks Encryption Service, Monitoring, API Gateway, Audit Logging, Authentication, SIEM, IDS and IPS. Overall security posture is HIGH RISK and requires immediate remediation.

instruction:
You are a senior software architect.

Convert the following system description into a CLEAN architecture graph.

RULES:
- Use only meaningful components
- No duplicate edges
- No redundant connections
- Keep architecture minimal and logical

FORMAT:
{{
    "nodes": [
        {{"id": "frontend", "type": "ui"}},
        {{"id": "api", "type": "service"}}
    ],
    "edges": [
        {{"source": "frontend", "target": "api", "label": "HTTP"}}
    ]
}}

CONSTRAINTS:
- Each edge must be unique
- Do NOT repeat the same connection
- Use proper labels: HTTP, DB Query, Async, Cache
- Node types limited to: ui, service, database, cache, queue, container
- Max nodes: 8
- Max edges: 10

Description:
Design a fully secured version of the following system.
Design a ai-platform system where model-serving, training-job, feature-store work together, backed by feature-db, artifact-db, with a user-facing entry point.
Embed the required security controls directly into the architecture.

ONLY return JSON. No explanation.
